Regulation: B.C. Reg. 161/2026
Made under: Provincial Sales Tax Act
Published in: No. 16 – B.C. Regs. 153 to 162, September 22, including September 8, 2026
Deposit date: September 22, 2026

B.C. Reg. 161/2026, deposited September 22, 2026, under thePROVINCIAL SALES TAX ACT[sections 236 and 241]. Order in Council 408/2026, approved and ordered September 21, 2026. On the recommendation of the undersigned, the Lieutenant Governor, by and with the advice and consent of the Executive Council, orders that, (a)	effective September 30, 2026, B.C. Reg. 114/2026 is amended by repealing section 4 of Schedule 1 and section 4 of Schedule 2, and (b)	effective October 1, 2026, the Provincial Sales Tax Exemption and Refund Regulation, B.C. Reg. 97/2013, is amended as set out in the attached Schedule. — J. OSBORNE,Minister of Finance; J. WHITESIDE,Presiding Member of the Executive Council. 1	Part 4 of the Provincial Sales Tax Exemption and Refund Regulation, B.C. Reg. 97/2013, is amended by adding the following Divisions: Division 4.1 – Accounting Services Exemption in relation to accounting services 82.1Accounting services are exempt from tax imposed under Division 4.1 of Part 5 of the Act. Division 4.2 – Architectural Services Exemption in relation to architectural services 82.2Architectural services are exempt from tax imposed under Division 4.2 of Part 5 of the Act. Division 4.3 – Engineering Services Exemption in relation to engineering services 82.3Engineering services are exempt from tax imposed under Division 4.3 of Part 5 of the Act. Division 4.4 – Non-Residential Real Estate Services Exemption in relation to non-residential real estate services 82.4Non-residential real estate services are exempt from tax imposed under Division 4.4 of Part 5 of the Act. Division 4.5 – Security Services Exemption in relation to security services

minutes_briefs.title: BC makes accounting, architecture, engineering, commercial real estate and security services PST-exempt
minutes_briefs.summary: BC has amended the Provincial Sales Tax Exemption and Refund Regulation (B.C. Reg. 97/2013) to exempt five types of services from provincial sales tax (PST): accounting services, architectural services, engineering services, non-residential real estate services, and security services. The change was made by Order in Council 408/2026 and deposited on September 22, 2026. Separately, effective September 30, 2026, sections of B.C. Reg. 114/2026 were repealed. The new exemptions take effect October 1, 2026.
minutes_briefs.action_required: From October 1, 2026, stop charging PST on accounting, architectural, engineering, non-residential real estate and security services, and update your invoicing and billing systems.

key_dates.label: BC PST exemption for accounting, architecture, engineering, real estate and security services takes effect

minutes_briefs.industries: Professional Services, Construction & Development, Landlord & Property Mgmt
